episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When a ghost turns up dead and train passengers go missing, Trese's investigation leads her to an aswang clan by the pier and a corrupt city official.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: In a flashback, Trese's father searches for a heart-stealing killer. Trese pursues the sons of two clan leaders who may be behind recent transgressions.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Ramona attempts a blood ritual to exact revenge. Trese, the "boys'' and Hank protect an actress as Trese receives a warning of "liars amongst allies."

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: While Trese fights to undo a spell that sent zombies to attack the police station, Hank tries to uncover details about the coming turmoil.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After a rash of bombings, the Council makes a surprising decision. Trese discovers who's been responsible for manipulating recent events all along.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: With humanity and the supernatural world both in danger, Trese confronts Talagbusao to fight her own destiny — and learns the truth about her father.
